**Settings** and **World** now show their parts as sections on one page, each with a bar you can open and close, in place of a side menu. Settings has General, Community, Schedules and Maintenance, then a link to edit the server as YAML. World has Backups, Web map, Past worlds and Tools. A closed section shows a short summary, such as "Public page off", and your browser remembers which ones you left open on each tab. Old links still land on the right section.

On phones, the MOTD editor in **Settings** now fits the screen. It used to run off the right-hand side, which made the whole page scroll sideways.
